parts.title: Green Vale Camp Site
parts.transcriptHtml:
Welcome to Green Vale Camp Site.

It's been only 2 weeks since the opening day of our camp site, so you are among our first visitors.

Our site occupies an area of around 500 hectares and we have lots of interesting activities.

I'm sure you and your children will have a wonderful time here.

Let's start by seeing what you can do at our site.

I hope you can listen carefully, so you don't miss any good places the site has to offer.

As I can see, many of you have brought your children here.

There are many activities for children.

We all know children like to run around, and we have many families here today, children might get lost.

{[But you don't have to worry, we have staff members at different spots at the camp to make sure all lost children will be sent to the stage.][1]}

So, you can go and find your children there.

And if you see kids who are wandering around and look like they are lost, please help us lead them there too.

{[If you want to hear some live music, you can go to West Field. Some local bands will be performing their new songs there.][2]}

A couple of them have won awards at the national competition last year.

{[Then there's green lounge, a place to relax, as there are tables and chairs. It also offers a wide variety of food, including burgers and pizzas, with a taste that has been highly praised by previous visitors.][3]}

{[Riverside is a beautiful area for a walk, and at 5 pm, we play some new movies. Today we will be playing a comedy. You and your children can sit on the grass and enjoy.][4]}

{[Next, it's the gateway, where children can have a lot of fun. There are swings and slides. They can keep your children busy for hours.][5]}

Then you can take a break and do something on your own.

Alright, let me provide you with details about the locations of some important spots at our site.

Firstly, we are currently at the entrance.

{[If you proceed straight ahead on Royal Way and turn left at the first crossing, you will find yourself on Green Street, where you will see a large area with tents, known as Meadow Campsite. This campsite is available for overnight stays.][6]}

For those interested in handpicking fresh vegetables, we have the Veggie Garden located at the corner of Royal Way and Green Street, diagonally opposite the camping area.

{[Continuing along Royal Way, you will come across the toilet on your left, and opposite it is Caravan Park, a beautiful park where you can even go boating on the artificial lake.][7]}

{[If you require access to cash, the cash point is situated to the north of the park. You'll see several ATM machines there.][8]}

{[In terms of dining options, I highly recommend the Green Lounge, which I mentioned earlier. It is located close to the western end of Hillside Road.][9]}

{[For those seeking a more upscale dining experience, I suggest trying Sam's Restaurant. Simply walk back to Green Street, pass the Veggie Garden and the bridge, and you will find it on your right.][10]}

Additionally, there is a pharmacy on-site, situated to the east of Hillside Road, approximately 300 meters ahead on the right-hand side.

All of these locations are open for your exploration, but please exercise caution, especially when near water, and be mindful of the environment during your visit.

If you have any questions you can see me at the information office, right here at the entrance.

I hope you enjoy your day here.

sentences.text: Welcome to Green Vale Camp Site.
It’s been only 2 weeks since the opening day of our camp site, so you are among our first visitors.
Our site occupies an area of around 500 hectares and we have lots of interesting activities.

And if you see kids who are wandering around and look like they are lost, please help us lead them there too.

It also offers a wide variety of food, including burgers and pizzas, with a taste that has been highly praised by previous visitors.

Today we will be playing a comedy.
You and your children can sit on the grass and enjoy.
Next, it’s the gateway, where children can have a lot of fun.
There are swings and slides.
They can keep your children busy for hours.
Then you can take a break and do something on your own.
Alright, let me provide you with details about the locations of some important spots at our site.
Firstly, we are currently at the entrance.

This campsite is available for overnight stays.
For those interested in handpicking fresh vegetables, we have the Veggie Garden located at the corner of Royal Way and Green Street, diagonally opposite the camping area.
Continuing along Royal Way, you will come across the toilet on your left, and opposite it is Caravan Park, a beautiful park where you can even go boating on the artificial lake.
